issues.on_page: Cemetery 23,169 + Recycling 7,501 = General Fund Public works 30,670 (p5)
issues.issue: the report counts Cemetery and Recycling under Public works, so streets/highways ties to the statement. By the category list, though, cemetery is normally health/welfare and recycling is utilities (refuse). This is a judgment call.

issues.path: detail capital outlay lines (Police p17, Park p17, Economic Development p18, Street Fund p11, Library Board Fund p16)
issues.extracted: Capital Outlay: <function> (computed from department column or fund name)
issues.issue: the 2026-11-12 FY2022 ruling says to add a capital outlay function only when it is printed. These five lines take their function from the department or fund name and are marked computed. Flood Control, Cemetery and Recycling stay plain 'Capital Outlay', so the treatment is inconsistent within the report.

issues.issue: the sum is correct and marked computed. However, the total is not printed, and the 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is never derived. Someone should confirm that a sum of printed cash lines is acceptable here.
